pipeline.labels: Independent synthetic continuous regression or3class float32

input_policy: Each width/cardinality/distribution shares the same training and request category draws across all4 output profiles; batches are prefixes of one2048-row request. Baseline creates fitted states and expected float32 bit hashes once. Both isolated packages restore exactly those states.
scope: Entire public FeaturePipeline.transform_array plus fresh shallow DataFrame copy per call, in separate actual composed/native-package processes. Fitting, restore, hashing, exact parity and imports are outside timings. No tree inference, accuracy data or benchmark normalization adapter in this synthetic phase.

guard_selection.rule: Choose the lowest universal row threshold where EVERY profile/width/cardinality/distribution at EVERY tested batch>=threshold has pooled median speedup>=1.10 and both paired-order speedups>=1.0. Prefer it if<=1000. Otherwise use the same rule independently in four predeclared metadata buckets, with unqualified buckets falling back. No additional buckets are invented from results.

metadata_buckets.rule: Require full source coverage with equal output multiplicity across all inputs; mixed/partial/unknown plans fall back. Each bucket threshold must pass every synthetic width, distribution, cardinality and output profile in that bucket at every tested batch above threshold.

guard_selection.fallback_controls: At1000rows, test object-string frames and all-categorical frames with33categories only in the last column, for widths1/32/512 and multiclass-Mean output profile. Baseline/current candidate exact parity and timing are recorded separately. A deployed guard must not introduce repeated>3pct slowdown on these synthetic fallback controls; initial controls diagnose the broad candidate and do not select row thresholds.
guard_selection.independent_real_replication: Freeze the synthetic threshold before looking at additional real batch timings. Compare all5 saved real fixtures at1,64,128,256,512,1000,2048 in balanced order with exact transform/prediction bits. Each eligible tested batch must improve in both orderings; overall raw geometric speedup>=1 and fallback controls must have no repeated>3pct regression. Failure rejects the guard rather than retuning from real fixtures.

limitations: Finite local CPU/pandas object-string categorical serving experiment, not a universal speed or accuracy guarantee. One-row behavior stays on existing path; custom/mixed/high-cardinality inputs fall back. Exact parity hashes cover every synthetic case in every runtime/pass.
